posts.text: i was reading SRF q1fy27 earnings call, sharing some updates: revenue came in strong at 5,033 cr (+32% yoy). operational ebit was 1,116 cr (+61% yoy), with overall operational ebit margin at 22.2%. chemicals business grew 26% yoy. management has retained the fy27 chemicals growth guidance of 15-20% and said finishing toward the upper end is possible. performance films & foil and technical textiles both had a very strong quarter (margins improved sharply). management said some of this was helped by temporary factors like supply disruption and inventory gains and they expect sequential normaliza…
